description:
Agent validation in `@after_verify` exits from the parallel checker with a stack trace and no file or line. The output-path message does not mention `output_schema`.

Owner: `jido.agent`; `jido.agent_evaluation`
Root cause: `lib/jido/agent/dsl.ex:109,116-120`; `agent/route.ex:259-264`
Claims: start-here.B2, start-here.B3
Repro (probe file: id prefix): `20_b_start_here`: `start-here.B2`, `start-here.B3`
Guides: `guides/start-here/first-agent.livemd:80`

Done when: Route validation failures compile to a diagnostic with file and line, and the output-path message names output_schema.

Source: guide-report triage, finding B31. Reproduction probes are gitignored and exist only in the main checkout under tmp/guide-reports/probes/. Full evidence: tmp/guide-reports/triage-findings.md and probes/results-*.md. Add a test and any contract change in this change, and remove or correct the listed guide text. The guides must be committed before a fix edits them.

comments.text: Fixed in 7ca4270, 885241a, 8b4cbcb. CompileError leaves through the parallel checker with the file and the defmodule line; not a returned diagnostic, which would need a private Elixir API.

title: Give Agent verify failures a file, a line, and a useful message
